fieldValues.title: Decisions are recorded in at least seven stores with no shared index
fieldValues.summary: On 2026-10-28 decisions were held in: the srs-programme decision log (109; 100 ratified), srs rfc-decision records (54), srs-rust ADRs (52), srs-web ADRs (27), srs-context decisions (32), the clerk's docs/decision-log.md (36 rows), PR bodies (srs-decisions blocks), issue comments (srs:answer), vignettes that hold owner rulings, and two separate projects (decision-logger, muDemocracy-decisions). Nothing lists them together, so a decision can be found only by knowing its store.
evidence: Counts by srs find and ls, 2026-10-28
Open PRs carrying decision blocks: srs-rust 2, clerk 1 (2026-10-28, after the day's cleanup)
source-documents/archaeology-2026-10-08 (unfollowed decisions, work lost in branches)
fieldValues.body:
- Each store has its own id scheme: UUID records, ADR-nnn, rfc-decision slugs, table rows.
- The owner's question (vignette e3069d0d): do we need a decisions server? This inventory is the baseline to measure against.
